create.name: Fred Haas
create.bio:
Fred Haas is an Austin-based coach, intuitive and energy worker. He spent more than thirty years as a civil engineer, running his own firm for two decades, before a long spiritual search led him to train as a life coach, an intuitive and an energy healer. He has worked with clients in this way since 2010, has taught coaching at Crossroads Recovery Coaching, and once served as board president of Recovery Coaches International. He also hosted a show on the News for the Soul radio network called Living a Guided Lifestyle.

His approach rests on the idea that each person already carries an inner knowing, and that life eases when we stop trying to solve it like a puzzle and learn to follow that guidance instead. Sessions take place by phone: monthly coaching packages built around regular calls, plus angel readings and mediumship sessions offered on a pay-what-feels-fair basis. His guided meditations, some built on practices from Master Choa Kok Sui, the Lord's Prayer or the Welcoming Prayer, work with grounding, the chakras, clearing personal energy and resting in a sense of the divine. Many of them are free on his website and on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Guided Lifestyle Coaching
courses.description: Monthly one-to-one coaching by telephone, aimed at noticing and trusting your own inner guidance and acting on it. Packages range from two half-hour calls a month to four longer calls with email support and short check-ins between sessions. A free first call is offered.

courses.title: Angel Readings and Medium Sessions
courses.description: Forty-five-minute phone sessions, either to receive messages from angels, guides or your higher self, or to connect with loved ones who have died. A small deposit holds the slot and the rest is paid on a pay-what-feels-fair basis afterwards.
courses.price: $20 USD deposit, then pay what you choose

free_resources.title: Fred Haas on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations on grounding, chakra clearing, heart opening and connecting with divine love, many with toning and sound. He also hosts an Insight Timer group for exploring energy practice.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations by Fred Haas
free_resources.description: A page of his recorded meditations to play or download, covering grounding, centring, chakra work, the Lord's Prayer and the Welcoming Prayer. They are free, with an optional donation.
